title: Add roster-grounded AI
summary: Night Roster gains a privacy-conscious AI layer for personal night briefs, natural-language roster questions, change summaries and allocation explanations while the deterministic roster engine remains the only authority for staffing and shared changes.
changes: Adds a compact Night brief beneath the personal Night hero that summarises the nurse's allocation, staffing state, meaningful overtime context and unresolved roster decisions without replacing the existing hero.

Adds Ask Night Roster, a roster-grounded assistant for questions about allocation, colleagues, breaks, staffing and recorded changes, with an explicit no-patient-information boundary and no ability to mutate the roster.
Adds concise change summaries above Changes tonight so recent staffing and allocation activity can be understood quickly after returning to the app.
Adds Why this allocation explanations that make clear the deterministic rotation, staffing and approved override logic made the allocation and AI is only explaining the effective result.

Adds an authenticated Supabase Edge Function for OpenAI Responses API calls with minimal structured roster context, store=false, authorised-account checks, output limits and a safe deterministic fallback when AI is offline or not configured.
Ships the AI client and styles in the installed PWA cache, adds iPhone and browser regression coverage, and preserves all existing roster safety, offline and write-path guarantees.
